title: Pasta Shells with Roasted Cauliflower, Chickpeas and Ricotta
description: A hearty pasta dish featuring roasted cauliflower, chickpeas, and ricotta cheese, topped with homemade croutons.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.quantity: ¼ cup, plus a little extra for serving

ingredients.name: bread (whole wheat, spelt etc.)
ingredients.preparation: cut into ½ inch pieces to make your own croutons

ingredients.name: whole wheat pasta shells or similar (elbow, rigatoni or penne work well)

instructions.text: Preheat oven to 425 F with rack in upper and lower 3rd.
Rimmed baking sheet: Toss 2 tbsp oil, cauliflower, chickpeas, salt and pepper. Arrange in layer and roast until cauliflower is tender and chickpeas are crunchy (~25 min).
Second rimmed baking sheet: arrange bread in single layer and toast until crisp (~10 min).
Pot: while waiting for steps 2 and 3 boil large pot of water and cook pasta. Add dash of salt and tbsp of olive oil in pasta water.
Drain pasta and mix cauliflower mixture, 2 tbsp oil and parsley.
Season with salt, pepper, and top with croutons and ricotta. You can drizzle with a little extra olive oil if you want.
